fixed.summary: An inline SVG shape's fill or stroke of currentColor now takes the element's CSS color, inherited from its ancestors (a data-tone, a role's ink, an explicit color), instead of always the style's ink.

The overlay primitive's top, bottom and center anchors now centre their child by its own size, so a label, icon or SVG can be anchored; they no longer give the child a flex display, which only a box accepts.
